name: Hammer Curl
common_faults: supinating at the top (changing the exercise)

substitutions.note: supinated grip; more bicep brachii emphasis

contraindications: elbow tendinopathy aggravated by loaded neutral-grip elbow flexion
resistance_profile: hardest at 90° elbow flexion; neutral grip reduces supination torque on the joint vs standard curl

provenance.notes: Neutral grip emphasizes brachialis and brachioradialis more than standard supinated curl. Often better tolerated by athletes with elbow pain during supinated curls.
